metadata.description: Declarative tool + MCP-server catalog for the Project Material Risk agent. In demo/test mode (IBD_TESTING=1) the agent serves the 15 in-process tools built in app/tools.py (which compute over app/domain/ and the seeded scenario); this file is the ORD-keyed catalog those tools mirror, used for the tool-dependency map (checklist 10.2) and catalog/consistency tests. ORD keys match asset.yaml requires[].
metadata.scenario: Project P-ALPHA-01 (Tower Alpha): structural steel 1000234 on the critical-path Level 3 Slab Pour (A-300) is 14 days late (confirmed 2026-10-30 vs required 2026-10-16), float -3, supplier ABC Steel (1001) chronically late (last 4: +9/+12/+8/+8). Plus a HIGH, a MEDIUM and a clean material.

get_project_material_requirements.description: Project material line items (material, required qty/date, activity, float).

parse_excel_project_schedule.description: Parse the Phase-1 Excel project schedule into structured activities.

get_open_purchase_orders_and_prs.description: Open POs/PRs with confirmed delivery dates, qty, vendor.

get_consolidation_material_master.description: Material master planning data (safety stock, reorder point, lead time).

compute_material_availability_gaps.description: Net-availability gaps and risk bands for every material in a project.

get_supplier_delivery_history.description: Last deliveries for a vendor x material with on-time rate and chronic-late flag.

predict_delivery_outcome.description: Predict delay range and on-time probability from history.

update_po_delivery_date_or_create_expedi.description: WRITE (gated): update a PO delivery date or create an expedite PO (advisory demo).

simulate_schedule_consequence.description: Simulate schedule + cost consequence of a supply gap; score recovery options.

draft_supplier_expedite_communication.description: Pre-populated expedite email for an at-risk material.

trigger_escalation_workflow.description: WRITE (gated): route a risk to Purchase Manager / Project Management.

retrieve_schedule_and_supplier_context.description: RAG retrieval over schedule rows, supplier emails and vendor scorecards (similarity gate + injection/PII sanitised).

write_intervention_outcome_to_memory.description: WRITE (gated): persist an intervention outcome to institutional memory.
